a.format.text_parser_utf8.moved: The pinned GAP was `text_parser_utf8:exit=101:panic-in-parser.rs` — the text parser PANICKED (exit 101) on a multi-byte character inside a comment, which is a crash, not a refusal: it cannot be told apart from a tool that is simply broken, and a crash on attacker-shaped input is never an acceptable resting state for a parser. It now returns rc=0 on the same input. NOT attributed to a single trust-ir commit: this pin had not been ratcheted across a range of parser work, and what this tree measures is the flip.
